name: Tachibana Misato
source: Misato is Hiroki's next-door neighbor and his long-time childhood friend. Because she worries about him way more than she should be, she always goes to wake him up, not to mention making him both breakfast and lunch. Because of this, their classmates often refer them as "a married couple", but at the same time Hiroki and Misato are less than lovers, but more than friends.
